'''Maria Livingston Simons''' is an editorial assistant to [[Team Jordan]] since 1996, serving as a continuity editor and research assistant to [[Robert Jordan]], as well as general personal assistant to both Mr. Jordan and his wife/editor, [[Harriet Rigney]]. She contributed heavily to the [[Wheel of Time Companion]] following the completion of the novels.

Maria is known for her poker-face and extensive knowledge, leading to the [[RAFO]] variant, MAFO (Ask Maria and Find Out).
